content: Bab-Dummad Pabloʼga igar-uksad

Ani Pablo, Cristo-nue-dulemar-sabedgi, degi, e-san-dummarba-imaksulidgi, bemarse wilesakwaa an egised. Emidi, an-annik sogmalad: An bemar-abargi gudiile, an naisdikii sunmakye. An bemar-abargi daklesulirdi, ibmar sabsur an bemarga sogdamarye.

Degisoggu, bemarse wilesakwaa an egised, nue nanamarye, adi, an bemarse mosale, melle ise-urwedgi an bemarga ibmar-sogegar. Ar dulemar anmargi sogdimalad, anmarde dule-binsaedba nanadimarye. Amargardi, sabsur-ibmar-soged, egi gwisgued, an guagwar gudiid.
Ar anmar we-napneggined-inigwele, anmar we-napneggi-dulemar-urwemaladyob urwenanaisurmalad.
Ar anmar, urwenaidgi, we-napneggi-gingimar-bulegan-ebulemalad an ebusurmalad. Anmar ebugedi, Bab-Dummad-gangued an ebumalad, adi, niamar-galu earegar.

Degine, anmar igarmar-Bab-Dummadgi-yolemamaid an obelodimalad. Deginbali, san-dummarba-imakleged Bab-Dummad-mer-wisguega-imaked an obelodimarbalid. We-ganguedba, anmar dulemar-isgudiid-e-binsaed-ogwaega an alamaknanaimalad, adi, Cristoʼba ibmar-imakmalagar.
Deginbali, bemar bela Bab-Dummad-sogedba be ibmar-imaksamalale, dule-Babba-ibsadisurmalad-sabsur-odurdakega an guagwar gudimalad.
Unnila asginbi bemar ibmar dakmalad. Ar dule-wargwen na Cristoʼgadye-sogele, insaodo, igi na ede Cristoʼgadi, deyob anmar Cristoʼgadmogad.
Ar an-ganguedgi an dummarba amba an sunmak-inigwele, gwen an bingeguosulid. Ar Bab-Jesús we-gangued anga uksad, bemar-ogannogegar, bemar-obelogegarsulid.
Mer be binsamalo, an be-odobgumalaga gardagi an bemarse urwesimarye.
Ar ade, gwen-gwen sogmalad, an gardagi ibmar sabsuli, degine, binnasuli an sogdaye. An bemar-asabindi, an nolloo daye, degine, an-sunmakedi gwen-bai itoledasurye.
We-dule-degisoged nue-insao, igi-anmar bemar-asabin-gwichisulile, gardagi ibmar sabsur-soge, an bemar-asabin deyob an ibmar imakbalid.

Dulemar-na-dukin-san-ogannoar-sunmakdimaladyob geg an yobi gumalad. Degine, anmar amar-ebo geg bengumarbalid. Ar we-dulemar na dukin ede-nued-gudiiye-sogdimaladi, degi, na emarbo muchub-muchub wilubdakdimaladi, weyob-damaladi igar-binsaedsuli-daedid, igar-nabiridsulid.
Anmar dogdar na-san-dummarba na imakosurmalad. Ar Bab-Dummad anmarga igar-uksadba an arbaed imakmaloed. Ar Bab-Dummad bemarse-bakar, bemargi-arbaega anmar-imaksad.
Ar anmar iduar bemarse arbisulina, soglegenad, anmar anmarga-igar-uklessulidba ibmar imaknaiye. Ar emigindi, anmar-inse bemarga Cristo-Gayaburba-Nuedgi sunmakapmalad.
Anmar dulemar-baid-arbaedgi san-dummarba imaksurmalad. Unnila anmar abedimalad bemar-Jesúsʼgi-bensulid gatik-nasgumaigued, adi, bemar-abargi gatik igar-maidba anmar arbaegar.
Adi, Bab-Dummad-Gayaburba-Nued baigan-yarse yoo dule-baid-ese-warmakedse, an egi sunmaknaegar. Adi, melle dule-baid-arbasadgi an-nug ogannolegegar.
Bab-Dummad-Gardagi soged:
Jeremías 9:24
Dule-na-dukin-san-ogannogedi, Bab-Dummad a-dule-abingasulid. Dule-Bab-Dummad-nug-ogannogeddi, Bab-Dummad a-dule-abingaed.
